steps.content: The maintenance platforms, barely holding together moments before, now wrench themselves out of alignment all at once. Nearly every foothold lurches in the same breath toward the most treacherous angle.
Even the Mania that had been drifting formlessly through the air coalesces under its pull, sharpening into countless slender black spines that come raining down from every direction!

steps.speaker: Misfortune Incarnate
steps.content: Do you see it now?! This is misfortune!

steps.speaker: Misfortune Incarnate
steps.content: It forces everything toward the worst possible outcome! And... no one can resist it!
At the very front, a single black spike drives straight for Lynn's face.
In the split second before it strikes, a warning sign, already loose, drops from above and to the side, slamming diagonally into the spike and deflecting it off its deadly path.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: Lynn! Look out!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Eh?!
The deflected spike whistles past her ear and buries itself deep into the wall behind her.
At the same moment, the metal plate beneath Letta's feet gives way, yet the fracture halts itself precisely at her heel, as if unwilling to take that final inch.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Hm... Time to give that pitch-black thing a taste of its own medicine. Let's see how it likes always falling just short!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Save the commentary, Lantern Girl!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: This thing's trying to wipe us all out in one go!
She raises her bow and lets fly a rapid volley. Three arrows fan out across the air at distinct angles, every one of them aimed for the thickest knot of dark mist coiled upon its chest.
The black incarnation furrows its brow and waves away the arrows with a sweep of its hand. The two forces stand evenly matched, neither yielding an inch of ground.
With every step it takes, the platform splinters apart beneath its feet.
And Murphy steps forward as well. The two figures advance toward each other through the same crumbling space, unflinching.
[CG]

steps.speaker: Misfortune Incarnate
steps.content: Do you really believe you can match me? Dear Murphy?

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Guess I'll find out.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: I want to see if this world will show me any path... other than the worst one.
The battle rips through the entire space, dragging everything deeper down with it.
From the corridor to the broken bridge, from the broken bridge to the warped hall, and finally crashing into that first area, the one overturned by the car, now a ruin beyond recognition.
Still, neither side can seize victory. Both have spent every last method, and neither can muster even the ghost of a proper strike anymore.

steps.speaker: Misfortune Incarnate
steps.content: One day, that fear will come back to you. You will still run. You will still expect the worst to happen first.

steps.speaker: Misfortune Incarnate
steps.content: And when that day comes, I will return! I will return as your deepest nightmare!

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: ...That's a problem for another day.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: At least right now, I know one thing for sure. There is another possibility besides misfortune!
The incarnation sneers coldly, offering no answer. It raises a hand and forces misfortune itself into solid form, ready to hurl it straight at all of you.
From the distance, the utterly ill-timed roar of an engine cuts through the air.
Vroom—vroom vroom—

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: ...Huh?

From the far end of the darkness, two crooked headlight beams flare to life. As though tracing a route that should no longer exist, the car has wound its way through a vast, meandering circuit—threading through shattered platforms, veering around collapsed door frames, smashing through the dangling rails—

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: You're kidding me?!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: How did it even get back here?!
The car charges forward, just as it did at the very start, barreling straight toward its target. Only this time, that target is not you.

The black incarnation folds in midair, its body bent into a lurching, broken arc. Its shell, already split through with countless cracks, finally gives way under the impact, and the purple-black mist detonates outward.

steps.speaker: Misfortune Incarnate
steps.content: No—

steps.speaker: Misfortune Incarnate
steps.content: This can't be!!
The car swerves drunkenly forward a short way, then screeches to a halt not far off. For good measure, the hood lets out a thoroughly undignified puff of smoke.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Holy ****.

steps.speaker: Misfortune Incarnate
steps.content: ...Why?
For the first time, it looks utterly lost.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Because you've always believed... that luck only ever tips one way. Toward the worst.

With a thunderous boom, the dense purple-black mist rolls outward in all directions like a tide robbed of its center. And in kind, the misfortune and Mania that Murphy had temporarily taken into herself begin to scatter and fade.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Deep-level anomaly core confirmed eliminated. Reality restoration in progress... Wait, the underlying physical structure is collapsing!
As Mania disperses, a wave of vertigo comes crashing over you. You realize, with a jolt, that everything around you is inverted.
Thanks to the residue of Murphy's misfortune, the entire space now lies flipped, meaning every last one of you is plunging headfirst in free fall.
Until the very end, misfortune remains by your side.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: A little warning next time?! I didn't even get to strike a cool pose—!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Hmm... looks like it's a diving activity now.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: N-no, wait! There's... there's still a cushion layer below us... right?! Right?!

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: According to my analysis, there should be.
But set against everything you've endured to get here, this is hardly more than a trifle.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief?! Chief! All personnel, deploy every maintenance airbag and buffer net on the lower level immediately! We have to catch them, no matter what!

steps.speaker: Everyone
steps.content: AHHHHHHHHH—!
The howling wind swallows her voice almost whole. You lash out with the crimson shackles, sending them straight through the air to snatch Murphy—the one nearest to you—mid-flight.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Chief?!

options: Hold on tight! Don't let go!

steps.content: After a fall that seems to stretch on forever, a soft white glow finally blooms below. It is the buffer netting and maintenance airbags, deployed automatically in the wake of the emergency repairs. In the next breath, everyone plummets into them with bone-rattling force.
